releases.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
releases.about: The third season of Kusuriya no Hitorigoto . In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother…

releases.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4
releases.about: The fourth season of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu . To save his stricken allies, Subaru faces a deadly desert to find the Sage at Pleiades Watchtower. (Source: Crunchyroll News) Note: Lucca Comics & Games pre-screened episode 1 early on November 1, 2025, prior to the Japanese television broadcast on July 8th, 2026.

releases.title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
releases.about: The fourth and final part of BLEACH: Sennen Kessen-hen . Destruction looms at the end of the Thousand-Year Blood War between the Soul Reapers and Quincies… as the death of the Soul King mirrors the collapse of the Three Worlds, distortions and omens of destruction start to appear in all realms. Fierce battles erupt throughout the Wahr Welt between the Thirteen Court Guard Squads and the Royal Guard. Ichigo learns…
